intro: A small, immaculately dressed child sits on the curb, bawling his eyes out.$Beside him floats a Pokémon you can hardly believe you're seeing.
speaker: Rich Kid
introDialogue: WAAAAH! All the other kids are at the park and I'm stuck here!$Mummy said I have to watch our {{mythicalName}} or I'm out of the will!$Hey… hey, YOU. You look responsible-ish.$Can you watch it while I go play?? I'll be back in like… five minutes! Promise!
title: Babysitting a Mythical
description: The child is already inching toward the park. The {{mythicalName}} looks at you with ancient, knowing eyes. This is either the luckiest day of your life or a terrible, terrible idea.

1.label: "Sure, I'll Watch It"
1.tooltip:
(+) {{mythicalName}} joins your party
(-) Surely there will be no consequences
1.selected: "THANKS! You're the best!"$The kid sprints off toward the park without a backward glance.$The {{mythicalName}} drifts over to your side, unbothered.

2.label: Decline Responsibly
2.selected: The kid wails even louder as you walk away.$Somewhere, a park playdate goes unattended.

outro:
Five minutes pass.
Then ten. Then an hour…
